test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who was appointed as the Chief Economic Advisor to the Government of India in January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**V Ananth Nageswaran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. V. Anantha Nageswaran** assumed the position of **Chief Economic Advisor (CEA)** to the Government of India on** January 28, 2022**.
 
• As CEA, he provides counsel to the government on economic affairs and oversees the preparation of the Economic Survey of India, which is presented to Parliament ahead of the Union budget.
 
• Holding the rank of **Secretary to the Government of India**, the CEA plays a pivotal role in shaping economic policy.
 
• In addition to his role as CEA, Nageswaran is a versatile professional with experience as a writer, author, teacher, and consultant.
 
• He has shared his expertise at various business schools and management institutes across India and Singapore, including serving as the dean of the IFMR Graduate School of Business and as a visiting professor of economics at Krea University.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Mamidala Jagadesh Kumar,** an Indian academician, electrical engineer, and education administrator, presently serves as the chairman of the University Grants Commission since February 2022. Additionally, he holds the position of professor in the Department of Electrical Engineering at IIT Delhi.
 
• **Sanjeev Sanyal **is an Indian economist and celebrated historian. He serves as a member of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister of India and has contributed to the preparation of six editions of the Economic Survey of India since 2017.
 
• **Madhabi Puri Buch** serves as the chairperson of the securities regulatory body, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). She holds the distinction of being the first woman chairperson to lead SEBI.
